career_highlights: Raised renewal rates on Cisco collaboration platforms from below 50% to over 70% by identifying adoption gaps, addressing technical blockers, and aligning architecture to business outcomes.
CSAP ASE, then TSS and Renewals SE.
Led cross-functional engineering teams at Honeywell as Scrum Master and Team Lead—sprint cadence, backlog priorities, delivery planning, and performance development.
Reduced test fixture setup time from 10 hours to 2 hours through Python-based automation (VM authentication, file versioning, cleanup).
Designed and implemented AI-powered automation tools at Cisco for the Renewals SE team.
Mentored and onboarded engineers domestically and internationally at Honeywell with structured retrospectives and feedback cycles.

personal.about_me: Connecting with others to put them in the best position to succeed. Remaining positive—there is always an opportunity to learn. Constantly growing by gleaning traits from others, applying them to myself, and giving back when there is a chance to teach.

pillars.name: Empathy
pillars.text: I went through this program myself, so I understand the pressure, uncertainty, and learning curve that comes with starting out. That experience helps me connect with and support early-career SEs in a genuine and relatable way.

pillars.name: Experience
pillars.text: My background spans engineering, presales, customer engagement, automation, onboarding, and enablement. That broad experience allows me to help early-career SEs develop not just technical skills, but the communication, adaptability, and business mindset needed to succeed long term.

pillars.name: Growth
pillars.text: I've grown from deeply technical roles into a strategic, customer-focused professional who understands business value, enablement, and leadership. That journey allows me to guide early-career SEs through both technical and professional growth.

career_blueprint.title: Career Blueprint Vision
career_blueprint.vision: I am an outcomes-driven and collaborative leader who fosters transparency, accountability, and trust through open communication, empathy, and adaptability, while aligning teams around shared business objectives and customer success. My leadership approach focuses on solving complex problems, enabling cross-functional collaboration, and creating an environment where individuals feel empowered, supported, and motivated to perform at a high level.
career_blueprint.results: Through a strong emphasis on customer adoption and strategic alignment between technical architecture and business outcomes, my team contributed to increasing renewal performance from below 50% to over 70% by identifying and closing adoption gaps, strengthening stakeholder engagement, and driving measurable operational impact.

quotes.text: I went through this program myself, so I understand the pressure, uncertainty, and learning curve that comes with starting out.

I believe effective leadership is defined not only by delivering results, but by building high-performing teams capable of navigating change, strengthening relationships, and consistently executing against organizational goals.

plan_180_day.title: First 180 days — before the cohort starts
plan_180_day.subtitle: Day 0–180 · prep runway, no ASEs in seat yet
plan_180_day.range_note: Prep window before CSAP/ASE cohort day 1. Day 0 through day 180.

0_30.label: Days 0–30 — Listen
items: Meet program owners, prior managers, sales leaders who'll host shadows
Audit CSAP/ASE materials—what's current, what's missing
Learn cohort timeline: hiring, start date, how many seats
Shadow active SE teams—refresh what good looks like on calls

31_60.label: Days 31–60 — Build
items: Draft week-by-week onboarding for day 1 of the program
Coaching rubric tied to CSAP milestones
Lock shadow roster with sellers before anyone arrives
Pilot AMA format with TSS peers as stand-in audience

61_90.label: Days 61–90 — Lock in
items: Dry-run onboarding; fix materials from feedback
Dashboard spec—what to track from cohort day 1
Mentor/sponsee matches lined up before start
Leadership sign-off on KPIs and success metrics

91_180.label: Days 91–180 — Ready at go-live
items: Final material pass; handoff docs if out
Pre-start sync with stakeholders on expectations
Runbook for the cohort's first 30 days once they're here
Day-180 checkpoint: ready or not for cohort start
